source_identity: Working-tree snapshots, including new uncommitted assembly files; hashes below define tested code.
configuration_meaning: App/harness compiled with DEBUG defined or omitted; same actual static AssistantSkills/AssistantModels modules. CLT defaults, not Xcode build schemes or iOS Release acceptance.
count_meaning: Assertion invocations per configuration, including repeated shared completion checks; not XCTest methods or 114 distinct scenarios.

actual_execution.document: Sources/App/SkillPDFAssemblyView.swift FileDocument compiled unchanged on macOS
actual_execution.runtime: Actual AssistantSkills runtime, NSFileCoordinator selected-file reader and PDFKit assembler; no substitutes or injected runtime.
actual_execution.catalog: BundledSkillCatalog.bundled() loads original pinned resource from temporary .app/Contents/Resources.
checks: Selecting files produces no receipts or output; prepare/assemble blocked until each file has separate read approval.
Duplicate read does not execute again; actual receipts and default order use actual page counts.
Reviewed source/page order and duplicate pages preserved; assembled PDFKit text matches each exact expected marker.
Editing raw orderText before SwiftUI onChange blocks assembly of the previous reviewed order.
Changing order while prepare is queued prevents obsolete review publication; explicit invalidation removes plan.
Result binds reviewed plan and actual SHA256; assembly status does not claim destination save.
Completed output cannot assemble again; replacement selection revokes old receipts and plan.
Invalid replacement and real missing-file read publish failure with no old success or filesystem path.
Both original input PDFs remain byte-identical after all operations.

scenarios: clear while real selected-file read waits
replace while real selected-file read waits
async_coordinator_cancellation.release_and_completion: Presenter callback always released; captured actual App Task awaited after Session drops its handle.
async_coordinator_cancellation.task_capture: Read-only Mirror of the App task property; no private OS API or state mutation.
async_coordinator_cancellation.observed: No obsolete receipt emission, result, status or running-state overwrite; replacement can read its own file after separate approval.

immutable_export.destination: Unique synthetic temporary directory, removed after checks; no native destination picker exercised.

geometry_patch_binding.scope: Rebuilt App checks against finite four-ULP geometry implementation. Fractional-geometry/bitmap assertions belong to separate core evidence; not counted here.

limitations: macOS App logic only; no iOS hosted XCTest or native picker/exporter UI execution.
Session.select is called with the two synthetic URLs; native file choice and UI approval button delivery are not exercised.
FileDocument snapshot and disk readback tested; SwiftUI exporter destination, cancel/completion callbacks and ReadConfiguration initializer are not invoked.
Clear/replace tested during an actual held coordinated read; assembly cancellation here is queued-task cancellation, not forced interruption during synchronous PDFKit serialization.
No hard peak-memory bound, visual equivalence proof, original Python runtime parity or remote deployment is established by this App check.
This evidence does not establish a complete iOS suite pass.
